Battle Garegga.name: Battle Garegga
Battle Garegga.summary: Battle Garegga is a vertically scrolling shoot'em up arcade game. The storyline takes place in a sort of diesel punk versions of the 1940s. Main heroes are brothers Brian and Jason — the sons of genius designer who want to destroy the evil Federation. Players control planes (4 air crafts to choose), fly forward, collect items and shoot to enemies. Unlike in most other scrolling shooter games, where bullets are brightly colored to distinguish from the background, bullets are realistically colored, making it difficult for players to see them. As a bonus, by entering a code, you can unlock four of the characters from Mahou Daisakusen.

Langrisser - Dramatic Edition.name: Langrisser I & II
Langrisser - Dramatic Edition.summary:
This is a remake of two games: Langrisser (known as Warsong in USA) and its sequel, Langrisser II – or, better to say, the enhanced version of this sequel, known as Der Langrisser.

The remake features the Ultima-style character creation (you choose between various answers to morally provoking questions) introduced in Der Langrisser, and also offers branching storyline (you can be good or side with the evil forces, if you wish).

Steamgear Mash.name: SteamGear Mash
Steamgear Mash.summary: SteamGear Mash is an isometric action-platform game. The player controls Mash, a small robot who sets out to rescue Mina after Gash abducts her. Gameplay combines shooting, platforming and puzzle elements across multi-layered stages, with Mash using attacks such as punches and bombs to defeat enemies and progress through each area.

Street Fighter Zero 2.name: Street Fighter Alpha 2
Street Fighter Zero 2.summary: The Sega Saturn port of Street Fighter Alpha 2 uses an arranged soundtrack and features new characters like Shin Akuma, Evil Ryu, EX Dhalsim and EX Zangief. It also includes an exclusive survival mode as well as an art gallery.

Vampire Savior - The Lord of Vampire.name: Darkstalkers 3
Vampire Savior - The Lord of Vampire.summary:
Darkstalkers 3 is the second sequel in the Darkstalkers series of fighting games by Capcom, originally released for the arcades in 1997. The game was originally planned to be released as Darkstalkers: Jedah's Damnation in the United States, but this title was only used in the arcade version.

New characters added in this version are Donovan, Huitzil (Phobos in Japan), and Pyron, with hidden characters of Dark Talbain and Oboro Bishamon .
